birth_definition: Creation of the laboratory subject record and associated developmental identity/lifecycle state.
decision_7_network_policy: NO NETWORK / LOOPBACK-ONLY PENDING EXPLICIT FINAL POLICY
exclusions: Grants NO implementation authority, NO launch authority, NO birth execution authority, NO production mutation authority, NO recovery authority, NO rollback authority, NO Gate-2 authority, NO network authority, NO self-modification authority, NO key issuance authority, NO subject authority; introduces NO developmental stages, benchmarks, or curriculum.
launch_definition: OS-level execution of the subject runtime.
m063_reference: M063 developmental gate architecture (options A-D analyzed, none implemented; recommendation C adopted by this decision)
rationale: Preserve the existing D3 security boundary and avoid overloading it with developmental meaning. Use the already-established birth machinery as the developmental boundary, while retaining launch as a distinct OS execution authorization. Keep security-sensitive capabilities separately authorized and preserve human control outside the subject trust domain.
scope: Architectural/governance definition only. Recognizes birth authorization as the developmental boundary; birth and launch remain separate; no new DevelopmentalEntryAuthorisation is created.
